events.x: The Tigray war was an armed conflict that lasted from 3 November 2020 to 3 November 2022. It was a civil war primarily fought in the Tigray Region of Ethiopia between forces allied with the Ethiopian federal government and Eritrea on one side, and the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) on the other. Outcome: Negotiated cessation of hostilities in November 2022; renewed fighting in 2026; TPLF fails to overthrow the federal government; Cessation of hostilities agreed upon by the Ethiopian federal government and TPLF; TPLF agrees to disarm (2 November 2022); Implementation agreement signed by both parties (12 November 2022).

events.x: The ongoing Ethiopian civil conflict began with the 2018 dissolution of the Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front (EPRDF), an ethnic federalist, dominant party political coalition. Outcome: Ongoing; Oromo conflict (1973–present); OLA insurgency (2018–present); Benishangul-Gumuz conflict (2019–2022); Tigray War (2020–2022); TPLF retains control of Tigray; Ethiopia–Tigray peace agreement; 2022 Peace Agreement nullified in 2026; Al-Fashaga conflict (2020–2022); 2022 al-Shabaab invasion of Ethiopia; al-Shabaab invasion of Ethiopia (2022). Cost: Dead: 100,000+ deaths (per UCDP); 2,750,000 internally displaced.

events.s: armed conflict between Oromo Liberation Army and the Ethiopian government
events.x: The OLA insurgency is an armed insurgency between the Oromo Liberation Army (OLA), which split from the Oromo Liberation Front (OLF) in 2018, and the Ethiopian government, continuing in the context of the long-term Oromo conflict, typically dated to have started with the formation of the Oromo Liberation Front in 1973. The insurgency has gained strength in recent years, though it is not sufficiently armed or organized enough to pose a serious threat to the government. Outcome: List of ongoing military conflicts; Ongoing; Start of peace talks between government of Ethiopia and the OLA on 25 April 2023.; Conflict resumes after peace talks failed in May 2023.; Peace agreement signed between major OLA faction and the Ethiopian government on 1 December 2024 and its members started moving into designated camps. Cost: Dead: 5,623 killed (per ACLED, Aug. 2018 – Dec. 2022).

events.s: war between North and South Korea, 1950–1953
events.x: The Korean War (25 June 1950 – 27 July 1953) was an armed conflict fought on the Korean Peninsula between North Korea (Democratic People's Republic of Korea; DPRK) and South Korea (Republic of Korea; ROK) and their allies. North Korea was supported by China and the Soviet Union, while South Korea was supported by the United Nations led by the United States under the auspices of the United Nations Command (UNC). Outcome: Inconclusive. Cost: Dead: 1.6–3 million civilians; 990,968 total South Korean casualties; 1,550,000 total North Korean casualties.
l: U.S. Army Center of Military History

'first Woyane') was an uprising in the Tigray Province, Ethiopia against the centralization process from the government of Emperor Haile Selassie which took place in May–November 1943. Outcome: Ethiopian victory; Revolt suppressed.
